item.title: NPGameDev / godot-mcp-toolkit
item.description: A Godot 4.2+ editor plugin that lets AI coding assistants work inside the editor over the Model Context Protocol. Consolidated tools cover 150+ operations across scenes, scripts, nodes, and playtests, and a GDScript extension API lets any project add its own tools. Pairs with the godot-mcp-server npm bridge; runs locally.
